name: Billionbrains Garage Ventures Limited
remarksWeb: During the quarter, 10,00,00,000 equity shares were allotted to the Groww Employee Welfare Trust (Trust) in connection with the Companys ESOP scheme, to facilitate transfer of shares upon exercise by employees.  As on March 31, 2026, a total of 1,79,80,291 options have been exercised by employees. Accordingly, the Trust holds a balance of 8,20,19,709 shares, being the difference between the total shares allotted to the Trust (10,00,00,000) and the shares already exercised.  The actual outstanding ESOP grants as on March 31, 2026, amount to 11,15,73,189 options. After adjusting for the 8,20,19,709 shares held by the Trust, the net outstanding ESOPs considered for disclosure purposes stand at 2,95,53,480 options.
